data.title: 埃塔 · 四越百货的建筑图
data.description: 巨大的绘图桌上摊着四越百货的建筑蓝图，埃塔趴在图纸边缘解说结构。年度最佳建筑师的招牌之作，出自这个随时会睡着的精灵之手。

data.promptProse: Over the blueprint of Mitsugoshi's flagship store, Eta explains load-bearing arches in the tone of someone about to nap. Crisp morning sunlight pours through tall studio windows across the vast drafting table, illuminating architectural blueprints and detailed wooden models with clean geometry.
data.animaCaption: Architect of the Year, they called her. Eta yawned through the ceremony, probably. Crisp morning sunlight pours through tall studio windows across the vast drafting table, illuminating architectural blueprints and detailed wooden models with clean geometry.
